query: 2020, john x morris, data, emnlp, university of virginia
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.year = 2020
  AND p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'
  AND (p.title ILIKE '%data%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%data%')
  AND a.name ILIKE '%john%morri%'
  AND i.display_name ILIKE '%university of virginia%'
ORDER BY p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: google united states, 2016, emnlp, sebastian ruder, a model of reviews for
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.year = 2016
  AND p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'
  AND a.name ILIKE '%sebastian ruder%'
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%a model of reviews for%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%a model of reviews for%'
  )
  AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%google%' OR
    i.country_code = 'US'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%a model of reviews for%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%a model of reviews for%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%google%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
